items.title: Integral and Movantis team up for LatAm FX liquidity
items.snippet: Movantis, the unified financial infrastructure platform leader in cross-border value movement across Latin America, has selected Integral's technology to strengthen its offering through third parties in the liquidity sector for institutional clients, including banks, payment networks, and digital asset operators.

items.title: Crypto custodian Komainu bolsters Dubai office
items.snippet: Komainu, a regulated digital asset services provider and custodian, backed by Laser Digital and Blockstream, announces the appointment of Edward Marlow as Head of Office, Dubai.

items.title: Clearstream hires digital transformation executive
items.snippet: Clearstream, Deutsche Börse Group's post-trade business, is appointing Philippe Mueller as Head of Digital Products and Transformation for Clearstream Fund Services, effective immediately.

items.title: CLS completes infrastructure migration with Kyndryl
items.snippet: CLS, a financial market infrastructure group delivering settlement, processing and data solutions, and Kyndryl (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, today announced the successful completion of CLS’s migration to a new data center environment.

items.title: ‘Customers are happier if we provide the full suite’: Why startups are embracing all-in-one finance platforms
SAP Taulio appoints CTO and CPO
items.snippet: SAP Taulia, a leading provider of working capital management solutions, today announces the appointment of Kirsten Loegering as Chief Product Officer, effective 28 September, as well as the promotion of Andrew Schafer to Chief Technology Officer.

items.title: The Smarter Path to Managing Payment Modernisation
items.snippet: At Sibos 2026, RedCompass Labs’ Robert Coakley reveals how banks can manage payment modernisation complexity by leveraging the ecosystem and AI.

items.title: Neonomics secures $4m for open banking
items.snippet: Norwegian fintech Neonomics has secured $4 million in new funding from existing shareholders, following a strategic transformation that has reduced its operating cost base by almost 50% while preserving its high service quality and existing customer base.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents from directly accessing customer accounts
items.snippet: Weeks after the launch of Meta's Muse AI assistant, Jamie Dimon says JPMorgan Chase is not going to allow outside agents to directly access accounts on behalf of retail customers.

items.title: NatWest enlists Nvidia to help its AI spending tool understand regional accents
items.snippet: NatWest has harnessed AI speech recognition technology from Nvidia to help its new audio-visual spending insights tool understand customers' accents and pronunciations.
